title: Analista de DHO Pleno
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Analista de DHO Pleno , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de People e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades

  • Planejar, estruturar e executar programas de Treinamento e Desenvolvimento e eventos corporativos;
  • Realizar o levantamento de necessidades de treinamento e desenvolvimento junto às lideranças e áreas internas, identificando gaps e oportunidades;
  • Desenvolver, aplicar e acompanhar ações de educação corporativa, onboarding e desenvolvimento de colaboradores;
  • Elaborar conteúdos, materiais de apoio e experiências de aprendizagem alinhados às necessidades da organização;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de treinamento e desenvolvimento, incluindo adesão, avaliações de reação, eficácia e demais métricas da área, propondo melhorias a partir dos resultados;
  • Atuar em parceria com lideranças e BPs na identificação de necessidades de desenvolvimento de pessoas e times, propondo ações e soluções adequadas a cada contexto;
  • Apoiar os processos de desenvolvimento e acompanhamento de colaboradores, incluindo feedbacks, PDIs e ciclos de desenvolvimento;
  • Apoiar a condução e o acompanhamento dos processos de avaliação de desempenho, garantindo organização das etapas e suporte às lideranças e colaboradores;
  • Atuar no acompanhamento das iniciativas de Clima, Cultura e Engajamento, apoiando a execução de pesquisas, análise de resultados e acompanhamento dos planos de ação;
  • Transformar resultados de pesquisas e outros dados de pessoas em insights e recomendações para apoiar a evolução do clima, da cultura e do engajamento;
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar campanhas de engajamento, comunicação interna e iniciativas relacionadas à Cultura;
  • Acompanhar rituais de reconhecimento e iniciativas de reforço dos valores e comportamentos esperados pela organização;
  • Apoiar a jornada do colaborador, contribuindo para uma experiência positiva e consistente nos diferentes momentos do ciclo;
  • Apoiar projetos de Desenvolvimento Humano e Organizacional, contribuindo para iniciativas de desenvolvimento, engajamento e experiência do colaborador;
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores de DHO, utilizando dados para avaliar a efetividade das iniciativas e identificar oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Conduzir entregas e projetos de média complexidade com autonomia, alinhando prioridades, prazos, escopo e stakeholders;
  • Antecipar riscos e impedimentos, propondo alternativas e soluções para garantir a qualidade e o cumprimento das entregas;
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos, ferramentas e práticas de DHO;
  • Apoiar a atualização de organogramas e estruturas organizacionais;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com as demais frentes de People, contribuindo para projetos e iniciativas conforme as necessidades e prioridades do negócio.


Requisitos

  • Graduação completa em Psicologia, Administração, Gestão de Recursos Humanos, Pedagogia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência profissional em Recursos Humanos, com atuação em DHO, Treinamento & Desenvolvimento ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência na estruturação e condução de iniciativas de Treinamento & Desenvolvimento, desde o levantamento de necessidades até o acompanhamento dos resultados;
  • Vivência com iniciativas de Clima, Cultura, Engajamento e Desenvolvimento de Pessoas;
  • Experiência no acompanhamento e análise de indicadores de pessoas, com capacidade de identificar tendências, oportunidades e propor ações a partir dos dados;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com facilidade para conduzir interações e construir relacionamento com diferentes públicos;
  • Organização, autonomia e capacidade de priorização, com habilidade para conduzir múltiplas demandas e projetos simultaneamente;
  • Perfil colaborativo e facilidade para atuar em parceria com lideranças, BPs e diferentes áreas da organização;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas Google e experiência com ferramentas corporativas, como Canva, Jira e Slack.


Diferenciais:

  • Pós-graduação em Educação Corporativa, Gestão de Pessoas, Desenvolvimento Organizacional ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com processos de avaliação de desempenho, feedback e construção de PDIs;
  • Conhecimento em People Analytics e utilização de dados para apoiar decisões de desenvolvimento de pessoas;
  • Experiência com ferramentas e sistemas de DHO, como plataformas de treinamento, clima, avaliação de desempenho e desenvolvimento de pessoas (ex.: Qulture.Rocks, Feedz, Sólides, Pulses, entre outras);
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de educação corporativa, como 6Ds e Kirkpatrick;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de definição e acompanhamento de objetivos, como OKRs;
  • Formação ou certificação em ferramentas de análise de perfis comportamentais, como DISC, PDA ou MBTI;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de assessment e desenvolvimento de lideranças.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.


O que oferecemos:

  • 🧾Modelo de contratação: PJ;
  • Modelo de trabalho 100% remoto: uma oportunidade de crescimento acessível para talentos em todo o Brasil;
  • ⚕ Plano de Saúde: mantenha-se saudável com nosso abrangente plano de saúde nacional com consultas online e presenciais;
  • ♀️GymPass/Wellhub: bem-estar completo para você cuidar da sua saúde física e mental com os aplicativos integrados;
  • Voucher Kit Escritório: receba um voucher para turbinar o seu espaço de trabalho e garantir seu conforto, comodidade e produtividade;
  • Férias remuneradas: desfrute de 30 dias de férias remuneradas por ano para recarregar suas energias e relaxar;
  • Programa Super-Get-Super: indique um talento e receba um bônus;
  • 😊Cultura colaborativa: nossa cultura é baseada na confiança, parceria e foco em resultados. Oferecemos um ambiente com autonomia e transparência;
  • Incentivo ao desenvolvimento: estamos comprometidos com a excelência e o aprendizado contínuo. Oferecemos avaliações semestrais, conversas de one-on-one, feedbacks construtivos, e muito mais;
  • Programa de Stock Option: possibilidade de se tornar sócio da empresa e participar diretamente do nosso crescimento. Somos reconhecidos como uma das startups mais promissoras do Brasil pela lista 100 Startups to Watch.



E aí, vamos juntos nesse SuperFoguete? 🚀

title: Analytics and Automation Specialist
description:
REMOTE ANALYTICS AND AUTOMATION SPECIALIST TO WORK WITH SYDNEY, AUSTRALIA AGENCY. 


About The Role


SOMO is a Sydney-based performance marketing and digital agency, with a small London presence, hiring a Digital Analytics & Automation Specialist to help deliver on a services agreement with a major client, spanning analytics administration, technical implementation, measurement strategy, and workflow automation. This is a hands-on role covering everyday system hygiene through to building automated processes that reduce manual reporting and operational overhead.


The role is structured around three core service pillars, plus a growing automation function.


Working Hours & Availability


This role reports into a Sydney-based team, so overlap with Sydney business hours is essential :


  • Core availability window (required): 9:00am–1:00pm Sydney time (AEST/AEDT), every working day
  • The remaining hours of your 8-hour day are flexible and can be worked to suit your own schedule/timezone
  • Given Brazil's timezone difference, this core window will typically fall in the evening to midnight for a Brazil-based hire, candidates should confirm this is workable for them before applying


Key Responsibilities


1. Admin Tasks (system hygiene & operational support)

Manage platform access (GA4, GTM, Looker Studio)

Update dashboard permissions

Set up and maintain scheduled reports/emails

Conduct system hygiene audits

Maintain progress tracking documentation

Acknowledge and resolve routine requests within same-day/1-business-day turnaround


2. Implementation Tasks (technical setup & troubleshooting)

Configure event tracking (form submissions, button clicks, etc.)

Build and maintain dashboards, with a strong emphasis on advanced Looker Studio usage and setup (GA4 also used)

Pull data from third-party platforms via APIs and manage API integrations

Perform ad hoc data extractions

Troubleshoot data discrepancies across platforms

Support integrations with other third-party systems as needed


3. Strategy Tasks (consultative & planning support)

Contribute to measurement framework design

Assist with attribution model development

Support privacy/compliance strategy work (e.g. cookie consent changes)

Help plan reporting infrastructure

Assist in journey mapping and insights workshops


4. AI Automation (new capability)

Design and build AI-powered automation flows to streamline reporting, data extraction, and routine admin tasks (e.g. using tools like Zapier, Make, n8n, or custom scripts)

Identify opportunities to automate repetitive workflows currently done manually across admin and implementation tasks

Build and maintain automations that pull from analytics platforms (GA4, GTM, Looker Studio) and push into reporting or notification systems

Document automation logic clearly so workflows are maintainable by others on the team


Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and advanced Looker Studio usage and setup  
  • Experience with event tracking implementation and debugging data discrepancies
  • Comfort pulling data from third-party platforms via APIs , and general familiarity working with API endpoints
  • Understanding of measurement frameworks and attribution modelling
  • Working knowledge of privacy/compliance requirements affecting tracking (e.g. cookie consent)
  • Demonstrated experience building AI automation flows — e.g. Zapier, Make.com, n8n, or custom integrations using LLM/API-based tooling
  • Strong documentation habits
  • Ability to work independently on assigned tasks while flagging proactive recommendations
  • Excellent English (written and verbal) — essential
  • Comfortable communicating directly with clients , including handling complex briefs and translating technical detail into clear, client-ready language


Nice to Have

  • Experience managing Google Ads campaigns and reporting on channel performance
  • Prior agency-side experience managing enterprise client relationships
  • Exposure to Python or JavaScript for custom automation/scripting


Working Arrangements

  • Must be available Sydney 9:00am–1:00pm (AEST/AEDT) daily for overlap with the Sydney team; remaining hours of the 8-hour day are flexible.
  • Standard client-facing hours are Monday–Friday, 9:00am–1:00pm AEST, excluding public holidays, unless otherwise agreed.
  • Tasks are formally assigned with defined scope and timelines.
  • Deliverables must meet a professional standard and align with the task categories above.
  • Four weeks annual leave, sick leave + 9 days of public holidays. These can be used for your local public holidays if you wish
  • Competitive salary in USD. 


Things You Should Know About SOMO

  • We are a Paid Media Performance agency. Our clients cover a broad spectrum of industries.
  • Our team is spread across AU, UK, Brazil and Argentina. Everyone is treated the same, same workers rights and benefits. With this comes the same expectation of professionalism and accountability, irrespective of the location
  • We’re very proud of our staff retention rate, our first South American Talent hired 4 years ago has grown to be an integral, senior member of the team
  • Continuous learning and improvement is a pillar of our business. We have time set aside every week for internal training and coming together as an agency to discuss

title: Recuperação de agendamento
description:
Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento;
  • Perfil operacional, organizado e proativo;
  • Boa comunicação e escrita;
  • Facilidade para aprender novos processos e ferramentas;
  • Gostar de rotina, execução e acompanhamento de tarefas;
  • Ser resolutivo e empático.
  • Modelo de contratação PJ.

Benefícios

  • Benefício de Saúde;
  • Crescimento acelerado baseado em performance, não em tempo de casa;
  • Ambiente onde quem se joga de verdade é reconhecido;
  • Suas ideias chegam direto em quem lidera, sem intermediários.

Responsabilidades do dia a dia

  • Entrar em contato com pacientes que iniciaram um agendamento, mas não concluíram o processo;
  • Identificar os motivos que impediram a conclusão do agendamento e auxiliar na resolução de possíveis dúvidas ou dificuldades;
  • Conduzir conversas de forma clara, empática e persuasiva, incentivando o paciente a concluir seu agendamento;
  • Apresentar alternativas de horários, profissionais ou especialidades quando necessário, buscando facilitar a decisão do paciente;
  • Realizar contatos ativos para recuperação de agendamentos e oportunidades que não foram convertidas;
  • Registrar os contatos realizados, motivos de não conversão e resultados das abordagens;
  • Acompanhar os indicadores e resultados das ações de recuperação, buscando melhorar continuamente a conversão dos agendamentos;
  • Atuar de forma organizada e focada nas rotinas operacionais, garantindo agilidade e qualidade nos atendimentos;
  • Contribuir para o aumento da ocupação e do desempenho dos profissionais parceiros por meio da recuperação de agendamentos.


Sobre o Fácil consulta

Somos uma startup que usa a tecnologia para inovar o jeito de agendar consultas, de forma fácil, rápida e a um preço mais acessível. Nossa plataforma não só facilita o agendamento de consultas, como também oferece um plano de benefícios que proporciona até 50% de economia em consultas, exames e tratamentos odontológicos, tornando a saúde de qualidade mais acessível a todos

Somos a união de pessoas talentosas com personalidades únicas, que carregam uma mesma paixão: impactar o acesso a consultas particulares de qualidade. Por isso, nossa responsabilidade é cuidar da experiência de cada paciente, assim como de cada profissional da saúde. title: Arquiteto de soluções - IA Microsoft
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?


Arquiteto de soluções - IA & Intelligent Applications


Estamos buscando um(a) profissional com foco em IA aplicada no Azure. Você vai atuar diretamente com clientes, liderando engajamentos técnicos de ponta a ponta: desde o design de arquitetura até a implantação em produção de soluções inteligentes com Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio e ecossistema Microsoft AI. O foco é remover bloqueios técnicos, acelerar adoção e garantir que as soluções de IA saiam do PoC para escala real.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Experiência com Fundamentos de IA e LLMs: Entendimento sólido de como LLMs funcionam, como o tokens, contexto, temperatura, hallucination e grounding. - Experiência prática com prompt engineering: system prompts, few-shot, chain-of-thought e instrução estruturada. -Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura de IA: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), agentes com tool use e orquestração de múltiplos agentes. - Familiaridade com avaliação de qualidade de modelos: métricas como relevância, fundamentação e coerência.
  • Experiência com Azure AI Foundry: Criação de projetos, deploy de modelos e configuração de endpoints. - Uso do model catalog, fine-tuning e avaliação de modelos dentro do Foundry. - Configuração de grounding com Azure AI Search (indexação, chunking, estratégias de retrieval). - Integração com Azure OpenAI Service e outros modelos disponíveis no Foundry.
  • Experiência com Copilot Studio: Experiência com criação de agentes no Copilot Studio na criação de tópicos, entidades, variáveis e fluxo conversacional. - Integração de agentes com fontes de conhecimento externas (SharePoint, sites, documentos). - Configuração de actions e conexão com Power Automate para automações a partir do agente. - Publicação e deployment de agentes em canais (Teams, web, outros)
  • Experiência com Arquitetura e Cloud: Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas orientadas a IA no Azure (AI Foundry + Search + Storage + Function/App Service). - Entendimento de segurança aplicada a IA: managed identity, RBAC, data residency, responsible AI. - Habilidade de comunicar arquiteturas técnicas para públicos técnicos e executivos.


Diferencial:

  • Experiência com Azure DevOps ou GitHub Actions para CI/CD de soluções de IA (MLOps light);
  • Familiaridade com Python para prototipagem rápida, scripts de indexação ou integração com SDKs de IA;
  • Conhecimento de Azure Functions ou Logic Apps para automação serverless;
  • Experiência com Azure API Management (APIM) para expor e governar endpoints de IA;
  • Familiaridade com conectores customizados e extensões de agente (Copilot extensibility);
  • Conhecimento de Azure SQL, Cosmos DB ou PostgreSQL para persistência em soluções de IA;
  • Experiência com Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) ou containerização de modelos/aplicações;
  • Familiaridade com monitoramento de IA: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, logging de prompts/respostas;
  • Certificação AI-102 (Azure AI Engineer Associate);
  • Certificação PL-100 / PL-200 (Power Platform);
  • Certificação AZ-204 (Azure Developer Associate);




Modelo de atuação: Home Office, mas precisa ter disponibilidade para viajar esporadicamente;

Contratação CLT


O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;



Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Cloud Architect
description:
Position: Azure Cloud Architect

Location: Remote - Brazil (EST time zone)

Contract: 6 month+ extensions


This is a remote role, with a preference for candidates based in the U.S. Eastern Time zone.


You’ll architect, design, build, and troubleshoot cloud solutions across a hybrid cloud platform, partnering with our Global Infrastructure, Security, Network, Enterprise, Application, and Data teams to ensure everything we ship is secure, compliant, and aligned with company standards and our global cloud strategy.


Day to day, you will:

  • Lead application modernization — re-platform and refactor workloads from IaaS to PaaS to improve scalability, cost efficiency, and maintainability.
  • Serve as Level 3 (L3) escalation for complex infrastructure issues, driving deep root-cause analysis and resolving problems that lower support tiers can’t.
  • Design secure-by-default architectures — embed zero-trust principles, defense-in-depth, identity and access management, network segmentation, and data protection into every solution from the start.
  • Partner with Security Architects on threat modeling and design reviews and ensure solutions meet Sodexo security standards and relevant compliance requirements.
  • Assess the technical impact of new solutions and how they integrate into the existing ecosystem, including impact assessments for new projects and technologies.
  • Design technical architectures with a clear focus on user experience, scalability, standardization, cost, and security.
  • Build cost-optimized designs — right-size resources, select the most cost-effective service tiers and pricing models (reserved capacity, autoscaling, PaaS consumption), and apply FinOps practices so solutions stay efficient as they scale.
  • Scope multiple concurrent projects accurately and deliver on time.
  • Identify process and knowledge gaps and work across teams to close them.
  • Map business and technology dependencies and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver solutions quickly.
  • Produce technical documentation and architecture diagrams.
  • Recommend solutions grounded in Sodexo Global Standards to keep consistency through this period of change.
  • Advise on how and where Cloud Platforms can be used across the Sodexo ecosystem and guide architectural choices in line with global standards.
  • Deliver end-to-end cloud infrastructure architectures and designs using modern capabilities such as PaaS.
  • Partner with architects across other disciplines (Enterprise, Data, Security, Network, Application) and engage the broader Cloud Competency Center community across regions.
  • Manage partner relationships and coordinate development efforts across multiple teams.
  • Champion the architectural standards set by the Global Cloud Competency Center and ensure alignment with global Enterprise Architecture principles.


Required

  • Azure architecture expertise — proven ability to design and implement cloud infrastructure, platforms, and applications.
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) or equivalent.
  • 5+ years in an Azure architecture role spanning IaaS, PaaS, and integrations.
  • 10+ years overall in cloud and IT infrastructure architecture.
  • Hands-on experience modernizing applications from IaaS to PaaS — re-platforming and refactoring workloads onto managed Azure services.
  • Experience with Azure AI services and assets — e.g., Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Search, and Cognitive Services — including how to architect, integrate, and secure them within the enterprise landing zone.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues such as L3 escalation, including root-cause analysis through resolution.
  • Strong grasp of cloud security architecture: identity and access management (Microsoft Entra ID / RBAC), network security (segmentation, NSGs, private endpoints, firewalls), encryption at rest and in transit, key management, tenant isolation, vulnerability management, and SIEM.
  • Hands-on with Azure-native security and governance tooling — Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Key Vault, Azure Policy — and secure landing zone design.
  • Hands-on background administering Windows Server, Linux, and the Azure Portal.
  • Cloud cost optimization / FinOps experience — cost modeling, right-sizing, resource tagging and governance, and using Azure Cost Management to track, forecast, and reduce spend.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps in a Scrum or Agile environment.
  • Solid understanding across cloud and infrastructure components — servers, virtualization, storage, network, data, and applications — to deliver true end-to-end designs.
  • Solid understanding of operating systems and networking. Experience in Window and Linux OS.


How you work

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • A strong problem-solver — you analyze issues clearly, communicate well with colleagues, and drive to quick, sound conclusions.
  • Adaptable and curious — comfortable picking up new technologies quickly.

title: Application Assistant I
description:
Make this the place where you grow!


Como NTT DATA Business Solutions, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa. Somos uma equipe de pessoas apaixonadas que impulsionam a inovação – desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e muito mais. Com a SAP no nosso núcleo e um poderoso ecossistema de parceiros como Microsoft e ServiceNow, continuamos aprimorando soluções e tecnologias baseadas em IA para que funcionem para as empresas – e para suas pessoas,


Com operações em mais de 30 países e reunindo 18.500 especialistas representando mais de 90 países, permitimos que milhares de empresas se tornassem mais eficientes e eficazes nas últimas três décadas.

Fazemos parte da NTT DATA, líder de US$ 30+ bilhões em serviços empresariais e tecnológicos, IA e infraestrutura digital, atendendo 75% da Fortune Global 100. Co-inovamos soluções com clientes e parceiros globalmente para impacto empresarial e social. Como um dos principais empregadores globais, a NTT DATA conta com especialistas em mais de 70 países. A NTT DATA faz parte do Grupo NTT.


Conosco, você tem infinitas oportunidades para pensar grande, agir com ousadia e assumir a responsabilidade. Faça deste o lugar onde você pertence, aprende e constrói sua rede. Make this the place where you grow!

Estamos em busca de um(a) Assistente de Aplicação para atuar no time de Customer Success, contribuindo diretamente para a excelência no atendimento ao cliente, análise de documentos fiscais e evolução contínua de nossos processos e soluções.


Principais Responsabilidades:


• Realizar a análise e o processamento de Notas Fiscais, boletos e faturas na ferramenta GUEPARDO APP Cloud;

• Atuar em grupos de apoio ao cliente, esclarecendo dúvidas e orientando sobre a utilização da plataforma;

• Configurar e automatizar regras de leitura de documentos por meio de expressões regulares (Regex), otimizando o reconhecimento automático dos arquivos;

• Contribuir para a evolução contínua dos processos de Customer Success e da experiência dos clientes.


Requisitos:


• Ensino superior completo ou cursando em Ciências Contábeis / Contabilidade;

• Conhecimento em documentos fiscais, com capacidade de entendimento, leitura e validação de Notas Fiscais;

• Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;

• Perfil analítico, organizado e com atenção aos detalhes.



Diferenciais:


• Conhecimento em Regex (Expressões Regulares);

• Experiência em áreas de Customer Success, Suporte ao Cliente ou Implantação.



Regime de Contratação: CLT

Modelo de Trabalho: Home Office


Somos a maior empresa de consultoria SAP do mundo para empresas de médio porte. Torne-se um especialista trabalhando em grandes projetos. Com as parcerias SAP Platinum, Microsoft e AWS, impulsionamos a inovação e adotamos novas tecnologias. Com a nossa visão e ambição, entregamos desempenho de alta performance.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Implementation Specialist
description:
Hospitality Implementation Coordinator – Sales & Catering Technology

Location: Brazil — Remote

Employment type: Full-time Contractor

English level: Advanced/Fluent


About the role

We are seeking Hospitality Implementation Coordinators to support the global rollout of a Sales & Catering platform across a large portfolio of hotel properties.


This is a hospitality implementation and project coordination role, not a technical support position. Each coordinator will manage a portfolio of hotels and serve as their primary point of contact throughout the implementation process.


The role is responsible for ensuring that hotel information is collected accurately, implementation activities remain on schedule, required training is completed, and issues are communicated to the appropriate teams. The successful candidate will coordinate closely with hotel properties, regional commercial stakeholders, corporate support teams, external vendors and technical resources.


Hospitality industry experience is the primary requirement. Technical experience is valuable but secondary.


Key responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary implementation contact for assigned hotel properties.
  • Coordinate hotel-level activities for the rollout of a Sales & Catering platform.
  • Guide properties through implementation milestones, readiness requirements and deployment gates.
  • Ensure required hotel data is accurately gathered, mapped, validated and entered into implementation workbooks and systems of record.
  • Follow up on missing information, corrections and data discrepancies.
  • Track implementation progress, critical deadlines and hotel activation status.
  • Identify delays and risks, take appropriate follow-up action and escalate issues when necessary.
  • Verify that required e-learning modules and training activities are completed before hotels advance to the next implementation phase.
  • Follow up with hotels that are behind schedule or have not completed required activities.
  • Coordinate between hotel properties, corporate support teams, regional commercial leads, external vendors and technical resources.
  • Facilitate consultation calls to ensure that platform configurations reflect each hotel’s operational and commercial needs.
  • Validate required participation agreements, billing arrangements and other property-level deployment requirements.
  • Maintain accurate implementation records, dashboards and status reports.
  • Provide regional stakeholders and program leadership with clear updates on implementation progress.
  • Support early-adopter initiatives and encourage hotels to begin implementation ahead of mandatory deadlines.
  • Help ensure consistent communication and execution across multiple implementation workstreams and hotel properties.


Required qualifications

  • At least three years of experience in the travel or hospitality industry.
  • Strong understanding of hotel operations and the impact that technology changes can have on property teams.
  • Experience working in or closely with hotel sales, catering, groups, events or commercial teams.
  • Advanced or fluent English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong project coordination, organization and timeline-management abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple hotel properties, priorities and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Strong relationship-building and influencing skills.
  • Ability to motivate stakeholders, reinforce deadlines and follow up consistently without direct authority.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving implementation risks.
  • Emotional intelligence, self-awareness and cultural sensitivity.
  • Confidence working with spreadsheets, implementation workbooks, dashboards, presentations and project-tracking tools.
  • Ability to work independently within a remote and internationally distributed team.


Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with Delphi, Delphi FDC, Amadeus Sales & Event Management or another hotel Sales & Catering platform.
  • Experience with Property Management Systems (PMS) or other hotel technology implementations.
  • Salesforce experience.
  • Previous involvement in hotel technology rollouts, system migrations, hotel openings or property conversions.
  • Experience supporting implementations across multiple hotel properties or regions.
  • Experience coordinating hotel teams, vendors and technical resources.
  • University degree in hospitality, business, project management or a related field. A degree is preferred but not required.


Ideal candidate

The ideal candidate understands hotel operations and has experience working with hotel sales, catering, groups or events teams. They recognize the operational disruption that a new system can create and can guide hotel teams through change with empathy, organization and accountability.


They are comfortable managing deadlines, following up persistently, maintaining accurate records and communicating with stakeholders at different levels of an organization. They do not need to be a technical specialist, but they should be confident working alongside technical teams and learning hotel technology platforms.


This role does not include

  • Technical product support or software troubleshooting.
  • Software development or system engineering.
  • Product enhancement or feature-request management.
  • Product testing or quality assurance.
  • Ownership of software defects or technical product issues.

title: Stablecoin BD Lead, LATAM
description:
About OSL Group

OSL Group (HK 00863) is Asia’s leading digital asset platform and fintech pioneer. As the first SFC-licensed virtual asset platform in Hong Kong, OSL bridges traditional finance with the world of digital assets, providing institutional-grade custody, Over-The-Counter (OTC) trading, exchange execution, asset tokenization, and stablecoin payment infrastructure (OSL Pay / StableX).

We are expanding our regional operational hubs and building high-performing teams passionate about shaping compliant, global financial infrastructure.


About the Role

We are seeking an ambitious, institutional-focused Stablecoin Business Development Lead for Latin America to drive the adoption and distribution of USDGO—the enterprise-grade, federally regulated digital dollar issued by Anchorage Digital Bank N.A. and distributed by OSL Group.

With LATAM rapidly shifting toward digital dollar settlement for cross-border trade, B2B supplier payments, and corporate treasury management, your mission will be to position USDGO as the premier compliant stablecoin rail across Brazil, Mexico, and Argentina . You will originate, negotiate, and close strategic partnerships with local payment service providers (PSPs), cross-border trade facilitators, neobanks, local exchanges, and corporate financial networks.


Key Responsibilities

  • Regional GTM & USDGO Positioning: Formulate and execute a B2B-centric business development strategy across Brazil, Mexico, and Argentina, emphasizing USDGO’s core differentiators: OCC regulation, GENIUS Act alignment, enterprise compliance, and 1:1 USD backing.
  • Fintech & Payment Rails Integration: Secure distribution channels by partnering with regional PSPs, payment gateways, and local clearing rails (e.g., Pix integration partners in Brazil, SPEI partners in Mexico) to power underlying B2B payment flows with USDGO.
  • Cross-Border B2B & Trade Settlement: Target supply chain networks, import/export corporates, and cross-border payment platforms to replace slow legacy SWIFT corridors with instant, 24/7 USDGO settlement.
  • Exchange & Liquidity Venue Partnerships: Drive USDGO listings, liquidity depth, and on/off-ramp integration across top regional exchanges and OTC desks (e.g., Bitso, Mercado Pago, Lemon, Ripio).
  • Corporate Treasury Adoption: Educate and pitch corporate CFOs, Web3 treasuries, and institutional platforms on leveraging USDGO for balance sheet management, corporate payouts, and inter-subsidiary transfers.
  • Deal Lifecycle & Integration: Oversee the end-to-end partnership process from origination to technical integration, working closely with regulatory, compliance, and product engineering teams.


Requirements

  • Experience: 4+ years of proven Business Development, Institutional Sales, or Strategic Partnerships experience in Web3 (specifically Stablecoins/B2B Settlement) or Institutional Fintech/Payments (PSPs, Cross-Border Treasury, FX).
  • USDGO & Regulatory Literacy: Strong understanding of institutional-grade stablecoin mechanics, reserve attestations, and compliance-first positioning relative to un-regulated alternatives.
  • Regional Expertise: In-depth understanding of the commercial and regulatory financial landscapes in key markets:
  • Brazil: Pix ecosystem, local central bank VASP regulations, and B2B FX settlement flows.
  • Argentina: Parallel market dynamics, corporate demand for USD-denominated liquidity/hedging, and regional exchange networks.
  • Mexico: SPEI rails, US-MX B2B trade corridors, and FinTech Law frameworks.
  • Network: An active network of decision-makers across LATAM PSPs, neobanks, import/export corporations, Web3 platforms, and regional crypto exchanges.
  • Languages: Native or fluent in Spanish and/or Portuguese, with full professional fluency in English.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience at a stablecoin issuer, global institutional exchange, or cross-border payment provider operating in LATAM.
  • Familiarity with Solana and multi-chain stablecoin infrastructure, API-based payment integrations, and enterprise wallet management.

With LATAM rapidly shifting toward digital dollar settlement for cross-border trade, B2B supplier payments, and corporate treasury management, your mission will be to position USDGO as the premier compliant stablecoin rail across Brazil, Mexico, and Argentina . You will originate, negotiate, and close strategic partnerships with local payment service providers (PSPs), cross-border trade facilitators, neobanks, local exchanges, and corporate financial networks.


Key Responsibilities

  • Regional GTM & USDGO Positioning: Formulate and execute a B2B-centric business development strategy across Brazil, Mexico, and Argentina, emphasizing USDGO’s core differentiators: OCC regulation, GENIUS Act alignment, enterprise compliance, and 1:1 USD backing.
  • Fintech & Payment Rails Integration: Secure distribution channels by partnering with regional PSPs, payment gateways, and local clearing rails (e.g., Pix integration partners in Brazil, SPEI partners in Mexico) to power underlying B2B payment flows with USDGO.
  • Cross-Border B2B & Trade Settlement: Target supply chain networks, import/export corporates, and cross-border payment platforms to replace slow legacy SWIFT corridors with instant, 24/7 USDGO settlement.
  • Exchange & Liquidity Venue Partnerships: Drive USDGO listings, liquidity depth, and on/off-ramp integration across top regional exchanges and OTC desks (e.g., Bitso, Mercado Pago, Lemon, Ripio).
  • Corporate Treasury Adoption: Educate and pitch corporate CFOs, Web3 treasuries, and institutional platforms on leveraging USDGO for balance sheet management, corporate payouts, and inter-subsidiary transfers.
  • Deal Lifecycle & Integration: Oversee the end-to-end partnership process from origination to technical integration, working closely with regulatory, compliance, and product engineering teams.


Requirements

  • Experience: 4+ years of proven Business Development, Institutional Sales, or Strategic Partnerships experience in Web3 (specifically Stablecoins/B2B Settlement) or Institutional Fintech/Payments (PSPs, Cross-Border Treasury, FX).
  • USDGO & Regulatory Literacy: Strong understanding of institutional-grade stablecoin mechanics, reserve attestations, and compliance-first positioning relative to un-regulated alternatives.
  • Regional Expertise: In-depth understanding of the commercial and regulatory financial landscapes in key markets:
  • Brazil: Pix ecosystem, local central bank VASP regulations, and B2B FX settlement flows.
  • Argentina: Parallel market dynamics, corporate demand for USD-denominated liquidity/hedging, and regional exchange networks.
  • Mexico: SPEI rails, US-MX B2B trade corridors, and FinTech Law frameworks.
  • Network: An active network of decision-makers across LATAM PSPs, neobanks, import/export corporations, Web3 platforms, and regional crypto exchanges.
  • Languages: Native or fluent in Spanish and/or Portuguese, with full professional fluency in English.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience at a stablecoin issuer, global institutional exchange, or cross-border payment provider operating in LATAM.
  • Familiarity with Solana and multi-chain stablecoin infrastructure, API-based payment integrations, and enterprise wallet management.

title: Revenue Accountant
description:
US Accounting Ownership. Long-Term Global Partnerships.


MAVI partners with high-growth US businesses, embedding experienced accounting professionals directly into their finance operations. This is not a back-office accounting role — you will be embedded directly within US finance teams, operating as a trusted partner to US leadership.


The Opportunity


We are hiring a Revenue Accountant to own the revenue cycle end to end for US-based clients — from contract to recognised revenue to cash.


You will work in lean, high-trust environments where revenue is the number everyone watches. You will own how it is recognised, why it moved, and whether it will survive an audit. Your accuracy and process ownership directly support business growth.


What You Will Own


  • Own revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the five-step assessment, performance obligations, allocation, and timing
  • Review customer contracts, order forms, and amendments for revenue impact, and flag terms that do not fit the established treatment
  • Own the deferred revenue roll-forward, contract asset and liability schedules, and unbilled receivables
  • Own the revenue close — journal entries, accruals, cut-off, and revenue reconciliations — within the monthly close calendar
  • Reconcile revenue and deferred revenue between the billing system, the CRM, and the general ledger, and resolve differences to root cause
  • Oversee subscription billing, invoicing accuracy, and the AR sub-ledger, and support collections with accurate customer balances
  • Prepare ARR, NRR, churn, and revenue reporting for US stakeholders, and tie it back to the audited revenue number
  • Perform revenue variance analysis and explain the movements — price, volume, mix, timing — in terms someone outside finance can act on
  • Maintain audit-ready revenue documentation, including the memoranda supporting significant judgements
  • Prepare revenue PBC deliverables and respond directly to auditor queries on revenue through to resolution
  • Support the broader month-end close, general ledger integrity, and supporting schedules alongside your revenue areas
  • Collaborate directly with US Controllers, CFOs, and finance leadership, and partner with Sales and RevOps on deal structuring and billing questions
  • Drive process improvements and automation across the contract-to-cash cycle


What We're Looking For


  • 4–6+ years of accounting experience with strong US GAAP exposure, including hands-on revenue accounting
  • Practical depth in ASC 606 — not familiarity, but having applied it to real contracts and defended the conclusion
  • Experience with deferred revenue, subscription or recurring-revenue models, and multi-element arrangements
  • Experience reconciling revenue between a billing system and the general ledger
  • Strong reconciliation discipline and the ability to investigate a variance through to root cause
  • Experience supporting an audit, including revenue PBC preparation and direct auditor contact
  • ERP experience (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks, or equivalent)
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort building schedules others can follow
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to explain a revenue position to a non-accountant
  • Availability for US time zone overlap


Preferred


  • SaaS, marketplace, or usage-based revenue experience, including ARR and NRR mechanics
  • Experience with billing and revenue platforms such as Stripe, Chargebee, Zuora, Maxio, Recurly, or NetSuite ARM
  • CPA, CA, ACCA, or an equivalent professional qualification, or active progress toward one
  • Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience
  • Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company
  • Experience through an ASC 606 adoption, a revenue system implementation, or a first audit


Why Join MAVI?


  • Own the revenue number for high-growth US companies — the line every investor and board looks at first
  • Build ASC 606 and recurring-revenue depth that travels with your career rather than with one employer
  • Long-term partnerships with high-growth US companies
  • Direct exposure to US finance and technology leaders
  • Broader ownership vs. traditional accounting roles
  • Flexible remote-first work culture
  • Opportunity to grow within a global finance network

title: Analista de Pedidos / Order Management - SAP
description:
VAGA TEMPORARIA 3 MESES - COM POSSIBILIDADE DE EXTENSÃO/EFETIVAÇÃO


Estamos buscando um(a) Analista de Order Management para atuar em um projeto temporário de 3 meses, em uma grande empresa multinacional.


Modelo: 100% remoto

Contrato: Temporário – 3 meses

Equipamento: fornecido pela empresa


*Principais responsabilidades*

  • Analisar e acompanhar diariamente a carteira de pedidos de vendas, seguindo os procedimentos definidos;
  • Analisar dados de performance e os principais KPIs da área;
  • Acompanhar atividades-chave de acordo com os níveis de serviço estabelecidos;
  • Identificar e comunicar riscos relacionados à operação;
  • Atuar em interface com a área de Customer Service e demais departamentos envolvidos no processo de faturamento;
  • Apoiar o alinhamento entre as áreas, garantindo o cumprimento da estratégia da companhia.

*Requisitos*

  • Alto nível de conhecimento em SAP;
  • Excel e pacote Microsoft Office;
  • Experiência com atendimento ao cliente, logística ou vendas;
  • Conhecimento de toda a cadeia de Supply Chain, desde o recebimento do pedido até o pagamento;
  • Forte capacidade de raciocínio numérico, analítico e lógico;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e com forte capacidade de resolução de problemas;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe.

title: Clinical Research Associate
description:
Join a growing international CRO and take the next step in your Clinical Research career.

We are looking for a Freelance Clinical Research Associate (CRA) in Brazil to support an exciting Infectious Disease clinical trial.


Our client is an international CRO supporting clinical research programs across a range of therapeutic areas, with a strong focus on scientific expertise, collaboration, and high-quality clinical delivery.


This is a great opportunity for a CRA looking to gain further experience within an international environment, and we are particularly interested in speaking with professionals who may be considering their first freelance/contract opportunity.


Key Requirements:

  • Previous experience working as a CRA within clinical trials
  • Experience with site monitoring and clinical trial activities
  • Strong understanding of ICH-GCP and clinical research processes
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Ideally based in Brazil
  • Available to work on a freelance/contract basis
  • Previous Infectious Disease experience would be advantageous


You do not need to have previous freelance experience — if you have a solid foundation as a CRA and are looking to make the move into contracting, we would be very interested in speaking with you.


If you're looking to build your CRA experience while supporting an exciting international clinical trial, apply now!

title: BIM Modeler
description:
BIM Modeler – Fire Protection / Sprinkler Systems (US Projects) | Revit MEP | Remote Brazil

NEW REMOTE OPPORTUNITY FOR AEC PROFESSIONALS IN BRAZIL!

Work directly with leading US-based engineering & construction firms.


Competitive Pay in USD | Full-Time (NY Schedule) | 100% Remote (Brazil)


We are hiring a BIM Modeler / Specialist focused on Fire Protection & Sprinkler Systems (Sistemas de Combate a Incêndio) to join the design team of one of our U.S.-based construction clients in New York.

In this role, you will work directly with the client’s engineering team to develop detailed fire sprinkler shop drawings, build 3D models using Revit MEP and AutoSprink, and ensure full compliance with NFPA standards. This is an ideal position for Mechanical, Civil, or Fire Protection Engineers in Brazil with hands-on experience in fire protection design (Proteção Contra Incêndio) and BIM coordination.


What We Offer

  • 100% Remote: Work from anywhere in Brazil directly for a U.S. client.
  • USD Compensation: Competitive rate with direct international payment.
  • Full-Time: Monday–Friday (New York / EST Schedule).
  • 18 PTO Days: Flexible paid time off for personal use.
  • Professional Growth: Direct exposure to U.S. building codes, NFPA standards, and advanced BIM workflows.


What You’ll Do

  • Develop detailed 3D models and construction-ready shop drawings using Revit MEP and AutoSprink.
  • Design, model, and coordinate fire sprinkler and fire suppression systems for commercial and residential U.S. projects.
  • Apply NFPA standards (particularly NFPA 13, 14 & 20) to develop fully compliant, constructible designs.
  • Perform clash detection and spatial coordination with Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Structural disciplines using Navisworks.
  • Proactively review plans to identify design conflicts and develop practical engineering solutions before construction.
  • Conduct QA/QC reviews to eliminate modeling errors and maintain organized project documentation/revisions.


What You’ll Bring

  • English Level: Advanced Technical & Conversational English (B2+ / C1).
  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in fire protection design, fire sprinkler modeling, or fire suppression systems.
  • Core Software: Expert proficiency in Revit MEP (mandatory); strong experience with AutoSprink is highly preferred.
  • US Standards: Deep knowledge of NFPA standards (NFPA 13) and U.S. fire protection practices.
  • Education: Degree in Mechanical, Civil, or Fire Protection Engineering, Architecture, or equivalent practical design experience.
  • Location: Must be residing and eligible to work remotely in Brazil.


Tools & Key Skills

  • Tools: Revit MEP • AutoSprink • Navisworks • AutoCAD
  • Technical Areas: Fire Sprinkler Design • Fire Protection Systems • Combate a Incêndio • NFPA 13 • BIM Modeling • MEP Coordination • Shop Drawings • Clash Detection


Local Search Terms / Target Profiles

BIM Modeler Brazil • Fire Protection BIM Designer • Projetista de Combate a Incêndio • Engenheiro de Proteção Contra Incêndio • Revit MEP Designer – Fire Protection • Fire Protection Engineer • Sprinkler Designer • Engenheiro Mecânico • Engenheiro Civil


About Cresta

At Cresta, we connect top talent in Brazil with leading engineering and construction companies in the U.S. You will work as a dedicated, full-time member of our client's team, collaborating directly on real-world U.S. projects while Cresta supports your ongoing onboarding and HR experience.


Ready to model safer projects for the US market from Brazil? Apply now and elevate your career! Note: Only CVs submitted in English will be reviewed.

title: Consultor de vendas
description:
Consultor(a) de Vendas | Veículos em Belém, Ananindeua e Altamira.


A área de Vendas é responsável pela comercialização de veículos novos , atuando na prospecção, atendimento e relacionamento com clientes, desde a identificação da oportunidade até o fechamento do negócio e acompanhamento da satisfação do cliente.


O Consultor de Vendas atua de forma consultiva, entendendo as necessidades do cliente e apresentando as melhores opções de veículos, condições e soluções, com foco em experiência do cliente, rentabilidade, atingimento de metas e alta performance comercial.


Desafios do cargo:

Prospectar e desenvolver novas oportunidades de vendas por meio de leads, carteira de clientes, indicações, contatos e demais canais disponíveis.

Realizar atendimento consultivo, identificando as necessidades e expectativas do cliente para direcionar a melhor solução.

Conduzir o cliente durante todas as etapas do processo de vendas, desde o primeiro contato até o fechamento do negócio.

Desenvolver relacionamento e gerar confiança, utilizando técnicas de negociação, persuasão e argumentação comercial.

Trabalhar com metas de volume, rentabilidade, acessórios, seguros, emplacamentos e vendas de seminovos na troca.

Utilizar o CRM e as ferramentas de gestão de clientes para organizar oportunidades, agenda, prospects, leads e acompanhamento das negociações.

Atuar com foco em alta performance, mantendo qualidade no atendimento e satisfação do cliente.

Principais atividades:

Realizar o processo de vendas de veículos novos.

Atender clientes no showroom e por meio dos canais de prospecção e atendimento disponíveis.

Realizar acompanhamento de leads, prospects, vendas perdidas e carteira de clientes.

Planejar e organizar agenda de contatos, visitas e oportunidades comerciais.

Utilizar o CRM para registrar e acompanhar as oportunidades de vendas.

Apresentar veículos, características, benefícios e condições comerciais de acordo com a necessidade do cliente.

Conduzir negociações e realizar o fechamento das vendas.

Acompanhar os indicadores de vendas e satisfação dos clientes.

Atuar na prospecção e desenvolvimento de clientes para ampliar a carteira.

Atuar na avaliação e negociação de veículos seminovos recebidos como troca, buscando proporcionar ao cliente uma percepção de avaliação justa.

Buscar o atingimento das metas de vendas, rentabilidade, acessórios, seguros, emplacamentos e demais indicadores definidos pela liderança.

Participar de treinamentos e ações de desenvolvimento promovidos pela concessionária e pela montadora.

Requisitos:

Ensino médio completo.

Desejável Ensino Superior em andamento, preferencialmente em Gestão de Negócios, Marketing, Vendas ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência com vendas de carros.

Experiência com técnicas de vendas e negociação.

Conhecimento em informática e Pacote Office.

Conhecimento de matemática financeira.

Boa comunicação verbal e capacidade de argumentação.

Habilidade para negociação e persuasão.

Perfil proativo, resiliente, ágil e orientado para resultados.

Facilidade para relacionamento com clientes.

Disponibilidade para trabalhar aos sábados.

Será um diferencial:

Experiência anterior em vendas de veículos novos ou seminovos.

Vivência em concessionárias.

Experiência com CRM e gestão de leads.

Experiência com prospecção ativa e desenvolvimento de carteira de clientes.

Experiência com vendas de produtos agregados, como seguros, acessórios e serviços.

Carteira de clientes ou networking comercial consolidado.

Experiência com vendas digitais e utilização de redes sociais para captação de clientes.

title: Arquiteto de Soluções SAP FInance
description:
Responsável por definir e governar a arquitetura E2E das soluções financeiras e fiscais no SAP S/4HANA, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em soluções escaláveis, seguras, integradas e alinhadas aos princípios de SAP Clean Core.

Atuará principalmente com SAP FI, FSCM e CO, garantindo integração com MM, SD, PP, MDG, Tesouraria, Impostos e Compras. Também será responsável por orientar integrações via SAP CPI/PI-PO, APIs, IDocs e BAPIs, avaliar riscos técnicos, reduzir customizações e direcionar extensões por meio do SAP BTP.

Trabalhará em parceria com Product Owners, Tech Leads, GPOs e áreas de negócio, participando da governança de arquitetura, documentação técnica, análise de incidentes e mentoria das equipes.


Requisitos principais:

  • Experiência como Arquiteto de Soluções SAP Finance;
  • Participação em pelo menos uma implementação completa;
  • Domínio de SAP S/4HANA Finance, FI, FSCM e CO;
  • Conhecimento de ACDOCA, New GL, Asset Accounting e contabilidade paralela;
  • Experiência com integrações SAP CPI/PI-PO, APIs, IDocs e BAPIs;
  • Conhecimento em Clean Core, SAP BTP, SAFe, Jira e ServiceNow;
  • Certificação SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI/CO) obrigatória;
  • Certificações em Impostos, MDG, Tesouraria ou SAP BTP como diferenciais.

title: SOX Audit
description:
Inviting applications for the role of Senior Consultant, Internal Audit & SOX!

In this role, you will be responsible for working on projects encompassing the entire gamut of Sox – from conceptualization to designing to implementation of the entire SOX program including documentation and control testing, evaluating internal controls, reliability of financial reporting, compliance with applicable laws and regulations and effectiveness and efficiency of operations including cost management. This should be a detailed SOX framework implementer role.

Responsibilities

  • Play a key role in the assignments including developing project plans, allocating resources, and leading staff members.
  • Handle SOX and Audit engagements.
  • Exposure to Internal Audit, Process Reviews, SOP, and other risk management engagements would be a positive.
  • Design and assess process and controls and drive improvements.
  • Ability to address queries on SOX and audit issues.
  • Understand the COSO 2013 and experience in process documentation, developing RCMs, report writing, root cause analysis, remediation and should be able to provide mentorship to the other team members.


Qualifications we seek in you!

Minimum Qualifications / Skills

  • Certified Internal Auditor or SOX diploma or CPA or equivalent
  • Experience in service delivery, team handling, work with all levels of staff and supervision of team members.
  • Good analytical and communication skills.
  • Good understanding of technical platforms and risk management practices.


Preferred Qualifications/ Skills

  • Preferred experience of working in international client facing roles on SOX and Audit engagements.
  • Qualified Accountant / Auditor with one or more degrees like CA, CPA, CIA, MBA

title: Bilingual Paralegal / Legal Assistant
description:
Company Description


CatalyzeX is a leading outsourcing partner specializing in delivering cost-effective and highly efficient labor solutions to businesses across various industries. We help companies scale their operations and achieve sustainable growth by providing top-tier talent and support.


Role Description


CatalyzeX is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Bilingual Paralegal (Spanish/English) to join our remote legal team. In this role, you will oversee the full lifecycle of case managementfrom intake through case closingserving as a central hub for document management and case organization. You will support attorneys and senior paralegals, ensuring all case materials are accurate, properly filed, and easily accessible, while helping maintain smooth workflows across the team.


Key Responsibilities


Case Intake & Opening

  • Process all new client intake information and documentation.
  • Create and organize new case files in legal case management systems.
  • Prepare engagement letters, conflict checks, intake forms, and other opening documents.
  • Coordinate with attorneys to ensure complete and accurate intake information.
  • Maintain case opening checklists to ensure consistency across all matters.

Case Management & Closing

  • Monitor ongoing cases and ensure case data is accurate and up-to-date.
  • Coordinate with attorneys to identify cases ready for closure.
  • Execute case closing procedures, including final billing, archiving documents, and updating case status.
  • Prepare case closing memoranda and coordinate return or destruction of client materials.

Document Management & Discovery

  • Serve as the central resource for locating and retrieving case documents and discovery materials.
  • Maintain organized electronic and physical filing systems with consistent naming conventions.
  • Manage discovery materials, including indexing, tracking, and archiving.
  • Conduct periodic audits of case files to ensure compliance with filing standards.
  • Support attorneys and staff in document preparation, version control, and proper storage.

Administrative & Client Support

  • Provide general administrative support, including managing emails, phone calls, and calendars.
  • Assist with scheduling meetings and coordinating case-related communications.
  • Serve as a secondary point of contact for clients, providing updates and addressing inquiries.
  • Draft, file, and process legal documents and correspondence as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bilingual: Spanish and English proficiency required; must be based in Brazil or Latin America.
  • Strong American English communication skills (spoken and written).
  • Knowledge of legal procedures, case management, and document handling.
  • Exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities with strong attention to detail.
  • Experience with legal case management software and cloud-based document systems.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Background in workers' compensation and personal injury law preferred.

Technical Requirements

Internet connection: High-speed internet required — minimum 20 Mbps or fiber connection

Computer / laptop: Employees must use a genuine, supported business laptop with built-in hardware security and full-disk encryption enabled. Unsupported, modified, bypass-installed, rooted, or jailbroken operating systems are not permitted.

  • Windows: Windows 11 (preferably Windows 11 Pro), 2021 model or newer, with TPM 2.0 enabled and BitLocker / Windows Device Encryption turned on
  • Mac: Apple MacBook / Mac, 2020 model or newer, preferably Apple Silicon M1 or newer, running a supported macOS version with FileVault enabled
  • Not permitted: Chromebooks (ChromeOS), tablets, and mobile devices are not supported and cannot be used for this role

RAM: Minimum 8 GB (16 GB preferred)

Noise-canceling headset

Power and internet backup required

Compensation: $7 per hour

Working Hours: Eastern or Pacific Time Zone


  • If you are highly organized, proactive, and eager to contribute to a growing legal team, we encourage you to apply. Please submit your application through our Careers Page ; only applications submitted via the career page form will be considered.

title: Senior Accounting Manager
description:
About MAVI


MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies. We maintain a deliberately high bar on both sides of the placement.


The companies we partner with are venture-backed and private equity-backed businesses building modern finance organizations, and the professionals we represent are operators with a track record of owning the numbers rather than supporting them from a distance.


Our team has built and scaled finance functions at companies including Lyft, Ramp, and SoftBank. We remain closely involved throughout the relationship, from role alignment and interview preparation through onboarding, placement, and long-term career development.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Senior Accounting Manager to run the accounting operation for US-based client companies, working remotely from Brazil.


This is a senior management seat reporting to the Controller or Head of Accounting, and it remains substantively hands-on. You will manage the close, manage the accounting team, and hold first-line accountability for the accuracy of what the function produces before it reaches final review.


Where a client has outgrown the processes that carried it this far — a close held together by one person's memory, a revenue schedule maintained outside the ledger, a reconciliation that has not been cleared in three quarters — you will be the person who fixes them and writes down how they now work.


You will work closely with the finance leadership, and directly with the operators whose decisions depend on your numbers. A significant part of the role is translating accounting information into something people outside finance can act on, and doing so before they ask for it.


Because your team sits outside the United States and the leadership you report to does not, the role calls for someone who runs their area without needing to be managed through it, escalates early rather than at review, and holds both the technical detail and the operating picture across a time difference.


What You'll Own


The Close and Financial Reporting


  • The close. Manage the monthly, quarterly, and annual close end to end, with accountability for the calendar, the quality of the output, and the cycle time.
  • The financial statements. Prepare the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP for Controller review, and answer for the numbers your team produced.
  • Review. Provide first-line review over journal entries, reconciliations, and supporting schedules, and send nothing upward you have not satisfied yourself on.
  • Revenue. Maintain revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the schedules and the deferred revenue roll-forward, and prepare the judgements behind them for review.
  • Consolidation. Prepare multi-entity accounting, intercompany balances, eliminations, and foreign currency translation.
  • Reporting packages. Prepare the monthly and quarterly reporting packages and variance analysis that leadership and investors rely on, with root-cause commentary rather than a restatement of the variance.


Controls, Policy, and Audit


  • Policies and controls. Maintain and enforce accounting policies, internal controls, and approval workflows, and recommend changes where the current design no longer fits the company's stage.
  • Documentation. Build and maintain the close checklist, process narratives, and standard operating procedures that allow the function to run without depending on any single individual — including you.
  • Audit. Manage the annual audit or review day to day, including PBC preparation, direct response to auditor queries, and resolution of findings, escalating significant matters to the Controller.
  • External partners. Act as the day-to-day point of contact for US tax advisers and outsourced bookkeeping partners, holding them to agreed standards and deadlines.


Accounting Operations and Team


  • The transactional cycle. Manage the general ledger, AP, AR, payroll accounting, and expense processing, holding each to defined turnaround and accuracy standards.
  • Reconciliations. Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and the resolution of ageing items, rather than the reporting of them.
  • Cash reporting. Prepare accurate cash reporting and the rolling cash forecast.
  • The accounting team. Manage, review, mentor, and develop the accounting staff and bookkeepers reporting to you, and give the Controller an honest read on where each person stands.
  • Finance systems. Lead ERP implementation and migration workstreams across NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, and comparable platforms, and support platform selection.


What We're Looking For


  • 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including direct management of accounting staff
  • Demonstrated ownership of a full close cycle and the financial statements on an independent basis, rather than contribution to someone else's
  • Strong command of US GAAP, with genuine depth in revenue recognition (ASC 606); leases (ASC 842) and stock-based compensation (ASC 718) are an advantage
  • Experience managing an audit or review, including direct response to external auditors through to resolution of findings
  • Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany elimination
  • A track record of tightening accounting processes and controls that were not working, and documenting them so they stayed fixed
  • Substantial ERP experience with NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, Sage Intacct, or a comparable platform, alongside familiarity with modern finance tooling such as Ramp, Brex, Bill.com, or Rippling
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort building schedules others can follow
  • Experience working remotely with US-based leadership, auditors, and CPA firms, with the communication discipline that arrangement requires
  • Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to hold the room in a leadership or audit setting
  • Contador Público (CPN) matriculado, CPA, ACCA, or an equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred
  • Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience preferred
  • Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company, particularly from Seed through Series C, preferred
  • Experience through a first audit or an ERP implementation is highly regarded
  • SaaS or recurring-revenue experience, including deferred revenue and the mechanics of ARR, is a significant advantage
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field


Who This Role Is For


This role is well suited to an accounting manager who wants to run an operation rather than administer one part of it.


You are technically strong enough to reach a defensible conclusion and show your work, and operationally strong enough to make sure the process behind it holds up next quarter. You build the discipline the company needs at each stage instead of waiting for it to be handed to you. You are comfortable reviewing someone else's work and telling them plainly when it is not right, and equally comfortable being reviewed yourself.


Above all, you identify issues early, communicate them clearly to the people who need to know, and arrive with a practical recommendation rather than only a number.


Why Join Through MAVI


  • Run the close and manage the accounting team, with direct visibility to US finance leadership
  • Build the accounting infrastructure of a growing company rather than maintaining someone else's
  • Work to US GAAP with US auditors and US systems, on the standard that opens international opportunities
  • Gain hands-on exposure to audits, ERP transformations, and control build-outs rather than observing them
  • Progress toward Controller, Head of Accounting, and Head of Finance opportunities through MAVI
  • Compensation in USD, paid reliably and on schedule


Work Arrangement


This is a fully remote role based in Brazil. You will be placed with a single US client company for the duration of the engagement rather than rotated across accounts, and you will work directly with US-based leadership, auditors, and external partners.


Core availability sits within the Brazil business day and provides full coverage of US Eastern hours. There is no overnight requirement.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
MAVI partners with high-growth US startups and SMEs, embedding experienced accounting professionals directly within their finance teams. This is not a traditional accounting role — you will carry the close for US clients and own real areas of their books in a fast-moving environment.


The Opportunity


As a Senior Accountant, you will run the day-to-day accounting for US clients, reporting to the client's Controller or finance lead.


This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will see the close from first accrual to final statement and own the parts that are usually spread across three people, with a US finance lead reviewing your work and available when a call needs to be made above your level. It suits someone who wants to carry a full set of books rather than process a queue within them, and who fixes a broken process rather than working around it each month.


What You Will Own


  • Carry end-to-end accounting (Record-to-Report) for US clients on a defined close calendar
  • Own the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close cycles, with accountability for cycle time and the quality of what you deliver
  • Prepare journal entries, accruals, prepaids, fixed asset schedules, and month-end adjustments, with support attached
  • Prepare financial statements under US GAAP for Controller review, and answer for the numbers you produced
  • Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and drive ageing items to resolution rather than reporting them
  • Maintain the supporting schedules behind the balances — prepaid amortisation, accrual detail, fixed asset registers, deferred revenue rollforwards
  • Handle and review AP, AR, payroll accounting, and cash reporting for accuracy and correct coding
  • Prepare variance analysis with root-cause commentary, in terms someone outside finance can act on
  • Act as a day-to-day US client contact, building strong working relationships with their finance team
  • Prepare PBC deliverables and respond directly to auditor queries in your areas through to resolution
  • Operate within the client's accounting policies and controls, and flag where a control is followed in form but not in substance
  • Maintain the close checklists and SOPs that keep the close reproducible without depending on any single individual
  • Propose process improvements and automation that shorten the close


What We're Looking For


  • 5+ years of accounting experience with strong US GAAP exposure
  • Demonstrated ownership of a full close cycle end to end, rather than contribution to one part of it
  • Experience preparing full financial statements, including cash flow, for review
  • Strong reconciliation discipline and the judgment to know when a balance does not look right
  • Experience supporting an audit, including PBC preparation and direct auditor contact
  • ERP experience (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks, Toast, or similar)
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort building schedules others can follow
  • CA / CPA / ACCA (or equivalent), or active progress toward one, preferred
  • Excellent English communication, with the ability to explain an accounting outcome to a non-accountant
  • Ability to work with US time zone overlap


Why Join MAVI?


  • Carry a full close end to end for some of the most exciting US companies
  • Own real areas of a growing company's books rather than one corner of them
  • Gain exposure to audit, ERP work, and process design earlier than a comparable in-house role would offer
  • Clear progression to Accounting Team Lead, Accounting Manager, and Controller roles
  • Flexible remote work with global impact
  • Compensation in USD

title: FP&A Manager - Remote (Work from anywhere)
description:
About the job

Own SaaS Financial Planning. Drive US Business Strategy. Lead from Brazil.


MAVI partners with high-growth US businesses, embedding experienced accounting and finance professionals directly into their teams. In Mexico, we focus on building long-term partnerships — where professionals operate as a true extension of US finance teams, not just offshore support.


This is not traditional outsourcing. You will work directly with US founders, Controllers, and finance leaders in lean, fast-moving environments.


The Opportunity

We are hiring an FP&A Manager to lead financial planning and analysis for US-based SaaS clients with structured corporate finance operations. You will own the full planning cycle — from budget build to monthly reporting — while acting as a strategic finance partner to US CFOs and business leaders.


This role is designed for an experienced FP&A professional who understands SaaS unit economics, recurring revenue models, and how finance drives decision-making in high-growth tech companies.


What You Will Own

  • Lead annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting for US SaaS clients
  • Build and maintain financial models covering ARR, MRR, churn, and unit economics
  • Own monthly variance reporting with actionable business commentary for US leadership
  • Partner with US CFOs and senior leaders on strategic planning and scenario analysis
  • Develop KPI dashboards and financial performance frameworks
  • Analyze SaaS metrics including CAC, LTV, gross margin, and cohort retention
  • Support board-level reporting, investor presentations, and fundraising data
  • Drive improvements in financial planning processes and tooling


What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of FP&A experience in SaaS or corporate finance environments
  • Strong understanding of SaaS business models, metrics, and recurring revenue dynamics
  • Experience working within or directly supporting corporate-structured SaaS companies
  • Advanced financial modeling and analytical capabilities
  • Proficiency with FP&A or BI tools (Anaplan, Adaptive, Pigment, Tableau, or Excel)
  • Advanced English with strong executive communication skills
  • Ability to work consistently in US time zone overlap


Why Join MAVI?

  • Direct partnership with US CFOs and SaaS finance leadership teams
  • Own strategic FP&A for high-growth US tech businesses
  • Exposure to corporate-level finance in a fully remote setup
  • Competitive compensation and long-term client partnerships
  • Fast-track path into VP Finance and CFO-track roles
